protocol: pre-extracted atomic claims -> RAGAS Faithfulness NLI -> human gold comparison
input_file: data/claims/ragas_eval_input_3534.jsonl.gz (gzipped JSONL; the .gz file-level sha256 is recorded in the top-level MANIFEST.json)
input_sha256_scope: sha256 of the DECOMPRESSED JSONL content (reproduce with: pigz -dc <file> | sha256sum); distinct from the .gz file hash in MANIFEST.json
